map.Ra 和 Rz 区别？: What's the Difference Between Ra and Rz?
map.Ra 是轮廓算术平均偏差，Rz 是最大峰谷高；同一表面 Rz≈4–7×Ra，Rz: Ra is the arithmetic mean deviation of the profile, while Rz is the maximum peak-to-valley height; on the same surface Rz ≈ 4–7×Ra, and Rz is more sensitive to sharp peaks.
map.粗糙度越低越好吗？: Is a Lower Roughness Always Better?
map.越低加工成本指数上升；按功能选，密封/滑动面需低 Ra，非配合面粗一点更经济。: Lower Ra means a higher machining cost index; choose by function — sealing and sliding surfaces need low Ra, while non-mating surfaces are cheaper slightly rougher.
